module: "Precision Parking" career debug tab. A button toggles the debug; when active, the module looks (every 0.1 s) for the delivery parking spot nearest to the player vehicle (accessPointsByName of the deliveryProviders), computes parking precision data and displays it in ImGui, with 3D drawings (spheres, lines, arrows via debugDrawer).
notes: If there is no player vehicle, debugData.error is displayed in red.

drawDebugMenu.desc: Draws the toggle button and, if active, updates then displays the parking precision data.

drawDebugVisualization.desc: Draws the 3D debug visualization if the mode is active.

onDebugDisabled.desc: Cleanup when the debug is disabled: turns off the mode and clears debugData.
